summary: Site page re-read: NG 001 still listed, Drive-In, Bicycle/Horse/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 30 ft, pull-in dirt driveway 140 ft, grades Slight, clearance 60 ft; count 1 and 30 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. CALENDAR: off sale ('Not Available') every night 11 Nov to 31 Dec 2026 with no reason posted, on sale again from 1 Jan 2027: status temporarily_closed written with that reopening date. Season left year-round (the page says 'Open year round' and the district publishes no closure). Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on, PASDA leaf-off): the pin is in woods about 12 m south of the road; a bare landing about 25 x 15 m lies roughly 37 m to its south-east at the end of a track, which fits the page's 140-ft driveway. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: STATUS (ruling 6 pattern, reported not asked): NG 001 shows 'Not Available' on every night from 2026-11-11 through 2026-12-31 and 'Available' from 2027-01-01 onward (calendar read 2026-11-10). No reason is posted on the site page, the district advisories page or the camping page, and there is no 'Walkup Only' label. The other eleven Tiadaghton sites in this batch are Available on the same November nights, so it is not a district-wide rule. Written as status temporarily_closed, reopens '1 January 2027 per the booking calendar'. If the owner would rather not carry a seven-week unexplained block as a status, drop the status group; nothing else depends on it.

PIN MOVE candidate (imagery estimate): stored 41.40529,-77.53507 (the page's GIS Details / approximate coordinates and the DCNR GIS point, all the same) is in woods about 12 m south of Narrow Gage Road. The only cleared ground nearby is a bare landing about 37 m south-east, at roughly 41.40500,-77.53486, reached by a track from the road; that matches 'Driveway Length: 140' (43 m). Under canopy in summer imagery; seen on PASDA leaf-off. Suggest 41.40500,-77.53486 if the owner wants the pin on the pad.

EQUIPMENT (rulings 4 and 8, reported not raised): the page lists 'Looking For Category: Bicycle Site, Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' with no 'RV Site' category; Max Vehicle Length 30, Site Access Drive-In. Kept.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', dirt. No caution line. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Water: the page says 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Less than 300 feet', but NHD has no flowline, area or waterbody within 200 m. Not waterfront, no lead.
NAME: the stored name carries the site's own number and road as the booking system gives them ('Site, Loop: NG 001, Narrow Gage Road'); nothing to change.

Equestrian/ATV check: the Tiadaghton horseback page names no horse camp; the ATV page names only the Haneyville ATV Trail (trailhead on SR 44 on its brochure map). The 2024 ATV Regional Trail Connector Pilot map linked from the advisories page answered 404 and is UNREAD.

Tiadaghton advisories page (read 2026-11-10): Brown's Run and Sinking Springs Roads closed to snowmobiles with a detour (2024-2025 season); 'Stay alert for ATVs' (ATV pilot uses some PennDOT, township and forest roads); a dust advisory for the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail; Dividing Line Trail closed indefinitely; e-bike rules. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice on this entry's road. The Tiadaghton camping page publishes no seasonal closure, hunting-season rule or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.'
